title: About The Gift Desk
description: C U R A T I N G T R A D I T I O N S , E L E V A T I N G C E L E B R A T I O N S "A gift remembered is a relationship renewed." At The Gift Desk, we believe a gift is never just an object  it is a message. Every diary, notebook and hamper we curate is chosen to carry your brand's intent with warmth, dignity and craft. We work with India's established manufacturing houses to bring you a range that spans PU leather notebooks, leatherette and hardbound diaries, executive planners and complete welcome kits. Every product in this catalogue is available for bulk supply, with customisation at the core  de-bossing, screen printing, foil and DTF branding, colour changes, bespoke boxes and inserts. From employee joining kits and festive hampers to conference giveaways and client gifting, we handle curation, branding, packaging and dispatch as a single desk. That is where our name comes from. description: C U R A T I N G T R A D I T I O N S , E L E V A T I N G C E L E B R A T I O N S "A gift remembered is a relationship renewed." At The Gift Desk, we believe a gift is never just an object  it is a message. Every diary, notebook and hamper we curate is chosen to carry your brand's intent with warmth, dignity and craft. We work with India's established manufacturing houses to bring you a range that spans PU leather notebooks, leatherette and hardbound diaries, executive planners and complete welcome kits. Every product in this catalogue is available for bulk supply, with customisation at the core  de-bossing, screen printing, foil and DTF branding, colour changes, bespoke boxes and inserts. From employee joining kits and festive hampers to conference giveaways and client gifting, we handle curation, branding, packaging and dispatch as a single desk. That is where our name comes from. BULK ORDERS Volume pricing across the entire catalogue CUSTOM BRANDING De-bossing, screen print, foil & DTF JOINING KITS Curated welcome kits, ready to dispatch EVENT GIFTING Conferences, festivals & premium hampers

title: J.HAMPSTEAD
description: A Journey of Style & Sophistication in Menswear . 1978 - SIYARAM’S Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd. has been a cornerstone in the Indian textile industry, known for its quality fabrics and innovative products. Over the yea  it grew into a leading player in the Indian textile market, known for its high-quality suiting and shirting fabrics. 1990 - OXMEBERG Siyaram’s recognized a growing demand for fashionable and contemporary menswear. This led to the launch of Oxemberg, a brand aimed at providing stylish, high-quality, and aﬀordable clothing for modern men. 1995 - J.HAMPSTEAD With a heritage of making high quality fabrics for the fashion conscious gen- tleman, J.Hampstead made its debut in India in 1195 and currently, has a pan India presence catering to leading retailers. The brand is known for its innovative fabric technologies and advanced man- ufacturing processes, which enhance the durability, comfort, and aesthetic appeal of its products. J.Hampstead stands out as a symbol of luxury, quality, and sophistication in the textile and fashion industry. As part of Siyaram’s Silk Mills Ltd., the brand has successfully carved a niche for itself in the premium segment, oﬀering discerning customers a blend of timeless elegance and modern style. Through its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability, J.Hampstead continues to uphold its reputation as a leader in premium fabrics and fashion.

title: Hugo Cailleton, founder of WACACO and master degree's holder in
description: industrial design, has been involved many years in the manufacturing of home espresso machine prior to initiate the development of the Minipresso. The idea of the portable espresso machine, allowing users to pull their own drink on the go, crossed his mind one morning during a business trip after having been disappointed by a poor espresso shot in a hotel. Back home, he started to examine available offe  bought samples and tested them. But none of those products satisﬁed him totally. They were too heavy, had poor extractions, shots temperature was too low and they were over priced considering their occasional use. Accustom to enjoy great shots day after day, his creative spirit was set to elaborate an easy to carry device, with performance close to home machines, allowing consumers to produce good espresso anywhere at lower cost.
